name: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
notes: KDA (Kimi Delta Attention), a gated-delta-rule linear attention with a bespoke chunkwise algorithm using a specialised DPLR transition. Interleaves KDA with full attention in a uniform 3:1 ratio, reducing KV cache 'by up to 75%' and giving 'up to 6x decoding throughput' at 1M context; Figure 7b measures a 2.3x speedup at 1M context and the paper notes a 'maximum hybrid efficiency ratio of 3:1 compared to full attention' for I/O-bound decoding.
